name: AsterPay MCP Server
description: Prepaid x402 spending budgets and European merchant discovery, orders, and EUR settlement workflows. Budget tools work without an API key; commerce tools require an AsterPay API key.

MODE.description: Server mode: seller or buyer. Buyer mode requires a daily or weekly spending limit.

ASTERPAY_API_KEY.description: Scoped AsterPay API key for live commerce tools. Not needed for budget tools or mock mode.

ASTERPAY_API_URL.description: Base URL of the AsterPay merchant API.

ASTERPAY_BUDGET_TOKEN.description: Existing prepaid budget token. Optional; budget tools can activate a token and persist it locally.

MERCHANT_SLUG.description: Merchant identifier for seller-mode commerce tools.

SPENDING_LIMIT_DAILY_EUR.description: Daily spending cap in EUR for buyer mode; at least one daily or weekly limit is required in live buyer mode.

SPENDING_LIMIT_WEEKLY_EUR.description: Weekly spending cap in EUR for buyer mode; at least one daily or weekly limit is required in live buyer mode.
